name: The Swamp Kitten — land creatures and/or creatures you control with menace get +1/+1
notes: The sweep's subject probe called the "creatures" words unread: its witness, a land creature with menace, fits both halves of "and/or", so swapping either word still reaches it. A probe blind spot, not a site bug. Here: your Dryad Arbor (a land creature without menace) and your Boggart Brute (menace) get +1/+1; Grizzly Bears and the opponent's Wayward Giant (menace) do not.
